# Python reference fixtures

`reference.json` contains 218 expected decimal integer answers generated from
the unchanged `contractnet/tasks.py` at commit `aecaea2` before the Rust migration.
These are independent oracle outputs, not values generated by the Rust code.

The first five cases are the original assignment's pinned golden answers.
The next 159 preserve all cases from `test_executor.py`, including its
`random.Random(370)` input generation. The remaining 54 cover negative seeds,
seeds beyond 64 bits, power-of-two moduli, and moduli beyond 128 bits.

Run `cargo test --locked` or `cargo run --release --bin verify -- --all --no-log`.
Do not change expected answers to accommodate implementation changes.
